description:
From the fz-kdt.119 cold review (2026-09-01): native_codegen/prim.rs
and native_codegen/receive.rs carry two parallel copies of
emit_runtime_type_predicate_{scalar,heap,struct,list}_checks under
identical names. fz-kdt.119's per-position recursion (per-field
tests, block scaffolding, OR-of-ANDs over shapes) would double the
duplication. Fold to one emitter before or in the same motion as 119
(feedback-fold-concordant-ideas). 119's spec item 4 requires it.
title: Fold the two native RuntimeTypePredicate emitters before they double
